item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
This Competitive Sealed Bid ( RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York City s online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82626B0018 into the Keywords search field.
